IF WALLS COULD TALK

INT. SECRET DOOR (LIBRARY) - DAY

David and Jayne stand in front of Nikolay's map of the EXIT ROUTES.

JAYNE

My dad used one of this routes to reach the altar room without being seen.

Jayne traces the map with his finger.

JAYNE

I don't know how. All I know is... you can reach it from here.

David kneels in front of a trapdoor in the floor. Above it, next to a painted arrow pointing down, are the words "ANYWHERE YOU CAN IMAGINE."

DAVID

Well, it's something. We'll just have to figure it out as we go.

He turns the MASTER KEY in its lock. Click! The door opens.

DAVID

Down the rabbit hole we go.

INT. EXIT ROUTE HALLWAY (2ND FLOOR) - CONTINUOUS

David and Jayne step down to a TIGHT HALLWAY lit by fluorescent lights. It looks uncanny. The door closes above them. They make their way through the hallway.

DAVID

Are we... downstairs?

JAYNE

We are in the walls.

DAVID

Looks like a normal hallway to me.

David and Jayne look around.

JAYNE

It's abandoned. The Reverend wanted most rooms to have only one entrance, so he closed a lot of them.

DAVID

JAYNE

DAVID

JAYNE

DAVID

It's like a labyrinth, a way to quieten the mind. Are you relaxed yet?

JAYNE

A little. I was afraid it was going to be creepier.

David puts both hands on top of Jayne's shoulder abruptly.

DAVID

(whispering on Jayne's ear.)

Are you afraid now?

Jayne jumps. He turns around, pretending that didn't happened.

JAYNE

Nuh-huh.

DAVID

It's a bit uncanny, but it's not that bad.

Jayne looks down at the picture of the map in his phone. He stops. Looks around.

JAYNE

I don't know where to go.

David looks up at text in the walls with an arrows under. It reads "FUN, FUN, FUN", "DON'T GO THERE", "THROUGH HERE". Not unsettling at all.

DAVID

Let's follow those.

David rushes towards the end of the hallway, there's a door in there. Jayne quickly follows, not wanting to be alone. David reaches the end. He looks towards the side and notices another small dead-end hallway with a door. An arrow points towards it "DON'T GO THERE". He ignores it.

DAVID

Why not?

He walks towards the door. Places the key and unlocks the it. Inside is-- A room decorated with fortune symbols and has a single SPIRAL STAIRCASE on the middle. David and Jayne stand on the doorframe looking down.

DAVID

This is new. What's this?

JAYNE

It leads to the altar room.

DAVID

And on first try. Damn. They really need to invest more on security around here.

David leans forward against the doorframe to peek out. Jayne grabs his arm, pulling him back.

JAYNE

Don't. You'll trigger the alarm.

Jayne looks up. In the ceiling, is a PEOPLE COUNTER.

JAYNE

That's their way of knowing no one is where they shouldn't be.

DAVID

Well, it works like ass. All I needed was your card to get in.

JAYNE

DAVID

We didn't have that problem in the library.

JAYNE

Not all rooms have them. Big rooms make it hard, and water makes them act weird.

DAVID

So... most rooms?

JAYNE

That's what this transition areas are for. We need one that goes directly to it.

DAVID

Fair enough. It was a good attempt.

David closes the door. He walks to the other door nearby. The text over the arrow pointing at it reads: "I HATE THIS PLACE". David places the key, opens it. The sound of chatter, clinking glasses, and music fills the hallway. In front is the--

INT. GAMING ROOM

David and Jayne stand on an open doorway in the middle of the wall. Down below is a small lounge area, isolated from the main gaming area. People cannot see them, but they get a clear view of the room.

DAVID

That's trippy.

David leans forward against the doorframe to peek out. He sees a door underneath a coffee table Jayne grabs his arm, pulling him back.

DAVID

There's one right there.

Jayne points at the ceiling. Close to them, is a PEOPLE COUNTER.

JAYNE

We can't use it.

David looks at it, he thinks about it.

DAVID

I got an idea.

EXT. GAMING ROOM (2ND FLOOR)

BEEP! BEEP! They key-cards open the door towards--

INT. GAMING ROOM (2ND FLOOR)

People play craps at the tables, lounge on couches, and shout over the noise. They weave through the room, dodging people left and right. It's overstimulating.

HEIMLICH (O.S)

David!

HEIMLICH sits at a table, playing craps. He waves at him.

DAVID

Hey, man! How's it going?

Oh, hi David.

Hey. You cut your hair?

Amazing.

David, Come grab a drink with us.

SAMANTHA

David and Jayne reach the small lounge area, kneel down next to the door, hiding from people. David places the key in the lock and looks up at the people counter.

DAVID

If you don't need your card to get out. There's no way for them to know how or when we left.

David opens the door. Down bellow is the DINNER HALL. David looks around.

DAVID

No counters in sight.

His eyes spot another door underneath a wall, near the top.

DAVID

I see a door.

David, I think it's safer to just walk down.

David kneels down into --

INT. DINNER HALL - CONTINUOUS

The trapdoor above them shuts. David pushes the door up, making sure it's locked. Then takes the key out.

DAVID

We're so close.

CLICK. CLICK. CLICK. The chandelier slowly detaches from the ceiling. Jayne looks at the attachment, scared.

JAYNE

(scared.)

David.

DAVID

Maybe this is it.

Jayne screeches.

JAYNE

(very tense.)

I hope.

David tries to reach the head of a statue under.

JAYNE

Please don't hurt yourself.

I got this.

As David keeps trying, the chandelier detaches on one side and tilts, Jayne slides towards David accidentally making both fall down. Before they hit the floor, a light shines around them; making them land like a feather falling, completely intact. Jayne looks down at the light, shining out from his hands. He turns to David, who's looking at him with a smirk.

DAVID

I guess it's not a secret anymore, huh?

Jayne closes his hands, the light disappears.

JAYNE

I don't understand why you can't. I mean, you're a blood witch. Aren't you?

I'm not a blood witch. My power comes from the box.

Isn't that what all witches do? take power

(hand gesture of throwing something out.)

Transform it into something else.

JAYNE

Jayne looks down at his bracelet.

JAYNE

It would be different if everyone was protected.

David helps him get up.

DAVID

We are on it. We'll hand out some cupcakes after this. Okay?

JAYNE

I mean it, David. If someone else gets cursed--

DAVID

(abruptly)

Can you get cursed?

Jayne stares, confused.

DAVID

I know it's a stupid question. I'm just curious. Let's say I die.

JAYNE

No!

DAVID

Okay, but imagine.

JAYNE

I don't want to imagine that.

DAVID

Okay. So, then. Let's say you didn't have a bracelet the day Harry died. And you were the only one in there, could you have gotten cursed?

JAYNE

The power flows through me. It can't get corrupted if it can't get stuck.

DAVID

Fortune flows through you. Crossed and cleansed, the ties undo... what does it actually do?

JAYNE

It hides you from Kismet. It can't get to you if it can't see you. But once you're marked... it keeps finding you. It means no harm, but your body can't take that power.

DAVID

Yeah, like any curse then. You just gotta... get it out.

David looks up at the door in the wall, close to the ceiling.

DAVID

This will work.

They climb towards the door, using the statues in the walls. David opens the door and steps up into the threshold, he stops cold. Jayne steps up to his side. They look down. Underneath, there's only darkness. It's like looking down a well. A GROUP OF MISSIONARIES enter the room, carrying ingredients for the red velvet cupcakes on bags.

MISSIONARY

Oh, yeah! We're finally the first to come back.

Behind them, the door on the wall is closed.

INT. EXIT ROUTE - CONTINUOUS

David and Jayne stand extremely close behind the closed door. They hold onto the door handle as they stand on the little space the threshold leaves for them. David places his ear on the door, there are footsteps and chatter outside.

DAVID

They keep on coming.

JAYNE

What do we do!?

David takes out his phone, he shakes it to turn on the flashlight. There's a metal ladder on the other side, no way to reach that.

DAVID

Shit.

They slip, trying to get back into the small space on the threshold.

DAVID

This thing is not big enough for the both of us.

(pointing down to the void under.)

Jayne takes a deep breath.

JAYNE

Okay. Last time. I swear. Never again.

David jumps down. He falls directly onto a pool of STILL RED WATER, the landing cushioned by an invisible force, he submerges on it completely. Then immediately comes back to the surface and moves to grab Jayne before he hits the water. He catches his on his arms, inches away from it.

JAYNE

Ew! Ew! Ew!

DAVID

Careful. Don't get wet.

JAYNE

Get me out! That's gross!

David laughs.

DAVID

I'm on it.

David walks to a border and places Jayne down. Then gets out, dripping red.

JAYNE

David, please stay back.

David lifts both of his hands up. Jayne points his flashlight around, grimacing. They are on a small aisle filled with water. His eyes catch a small opening on the wall near the floor. He gets down and crawls inside into--

INT. UNDERGROUND TUNNEL

The tunnel is bricked, with yellow tiles and dimly lit. Despite being abandoned, it doesn't feel like it. Jayne stands up, looks around disoriented. David follows behind. Jayne turns around and freezes. David is completely soaked in red water, his clothes are dripping wet. He places his hand over his mouth. David looks down at himself.

DAVID

It's that bad?

JAYNE

Yes.

DAVID

I don't have spare clothes. Lemme come up with an excuse for this. Hmm.

JAYNE

What's under the dinner hall?

The altar room.

DAVID

Is this the abandoned subway station the church was built over?

JAYNE

JAYNE

JAYNE

I cursed you.

DAVID

JAYNE

(low.)

I really want to.

David looks back, there's only darkness.

DAVID

Hey, so. How big is this altar room?

JAYNE

Not that big.

DAVID

Jayne looks back.

JAYNE

DAVID

EXT. CENTRAL PARK - CONTINUOUS

David peeks up from the door. He's surrounded by trees and grass. He looks around and spots a group of people eating on some outdoor tables outside a MOOR DIARY.

HARRY gets out of a Moor Diary near a lake, holding a bag with warm hash browns. He looks into the distance. New York.

Nikolay sits on Harry's bed, wearing his clothes and looking around curious. He kicks his legs happily as he eats the entire bag of hash browns.

INT. INTERVIEW ROOM - DAY

The FIRE MARSHAL REPORT and the AUTOPSY are on the table. Casper flips through them, showing them to Sylvie as she speaks.

CASPER

The reason we were having so much issues is because of the ACL tear. Dr. Padilla said it could mean he was either pushed or accidentally slipped..

With naphtha being so slippery and Harry being drowsy from the antihistamines, he accidentally slipped while smoking, making the lighter fall to the puddle and cause tje flash fire.

CASPER

Sylvie.

CASPER

Listen, I'll check one last time. If something comes up. I promise you I'll pull out the file. But the trail has gone cold, and I need to get back to my other cases.

Sylvie nods.

SYLVIE

You're right. You're the detective, but I'm "the conspiracist". Go back to your cases, Casper. I'll get you that something.

INT. AISLE WITH STILL RED WATER (UNDERGROUND)

David pushes Jayne up towards a passage in the wall, on the other side from where they came from. Jayne crawls towards a door at it's end. He opens it and jumps down towards --

INT. THERMAL BATHS - CONTINUOUS

JAYNE

(as he gives David the clothes.)

This was Harry's. You could use it for now.

David unfolds a GRAY JOHN JAY'S HODDIE. Jayne sits atop the lockers, framed by a door behind him, looking down. David steps closer, wearing Harry's clothes. INT. TOWER - DAY

A trapdoor opens on the floor. David emerges, carrying the bundle. He gets up and extends a hand to Jayne, pulling him up from the ground The voice of a Deacon leading the worship service echoes from outside the room. David opens a door and peeks out.

INT. CHURCH NAVE - CONTINUOUS

DEACON (O.S)

INT. PIANO ROOM - CONTINUOUS
